title: Sergey Shumakov
content:
Sergey has significant Corporate finance and M&A experience including development of financial models, investment memorandums, fund raising and organizing M&A transactions support for projects in different sectors (including retail, pulp and paper, TMT, fintech and others). Prior to joining RB Partners Sergey worked as an analyst in RB Invest, Althaus and Global Finance.
Sergey has BSc and MSc in Economics degree, Moscow State University of International Relations.

title: Galina Zhukovskaya
content: Galina has significant experience in MIS implementation and corporate management. Before joining RB Partners Galina was a Head of Planning and Reporting at Alfa-Bank. Galina graduated from the Plekhanov Russian University of Economics. Galina is in charge of the Company's corporate management.

title: Tianrong Lai
content: Tianrong has significant practical experience in consulting and marketing. Prior to joining RB Partners Tianrong worked in American company EMC, Russian Railways Group and consulting company Impex Consult. Tianrong graduated with honors from the Shandong University with a Bachelor degree in Marketing and Russian language and has a Master degree in the Graduate School of Management of St. Petersburg University. Tianrong is responsible for cooperation with the Chinese counterparties.

title: Alexey Glotov
content: Alexey has more than 20 years’ experience in the field of corporate finance and banking. Alexey graduated from the Financial Academy of the Russian Government. Prior to joining RB Partners, Alexey was in charge of corporate finance in VTB bank, Alfa-Bank, Nordea and SMP banks. Alexey is in charge of projects in the field of debt financing.

title: Natalia Pribytkina
content: Natalia has more than 15 years' experience in finance, corporate banking and international business development. Natalia has an extensive experience and expertise in managing the International Business and Foreign Investments Department of PSСB Bank, she also worked with Russian and Foreign banks in St. Petersburg and Moscow. Natalia graduated from the St. Petersburg State University, Economic Faculty with major in “Mathematical Methods in Economics” in 2002. Natalia holds an MBA degree from the TRIUM Global Executive MBA Program, an alliance of the NYU Stern School of Business, the London School of Economics and Political Science and HEC School of Management-graduated in 2015. Natalia is in charge of projects in the field of Corporate Finance and M&A in North-Western Federal District.

title: Konstantin Zubov
content: Konstantin has more than 20 years’ experience in the financial sector in the field of leadership in solution development and project management. He has considerable practical experience regarding the implementation of methodological and technological solutions, system analysis and optimization of the business processes. Konstantin graduated from Lomonosov Moscow State University majoring in the Applied Mathematics. Konstantin is in charge of projects in venture investments.

title: Roman Solovyev
content: Roman has more than 15 years of experience in coprorate management, including 10 years of experience on executive positions in the leading international and Russian consulting companies, such as BDO, Energy Consulting Group, Tekhnoserv Group, in which he was responsible for company's strategy development, establishment of business processes, staff recruitment and motivation of personnel. Roman has experience in project management in HR consulting: the assessment-centers, the description and optimization of business processes of HR management within the implementation projects of corporate information systems, headcount optimization, etc. Roman graduated with honors from the Moscow State University of Design and Technology with a degree in Psychology. Roman is in charge of establishment and support for Group operating activities.

title: Grigory Oganesyan
content: Grigory has significant practical experience in Corporate Finance, including M&A and ECM transactions. Prior to joining RB Partners he worked at the Investment Banking department of BNP Paribas in Paris and London, as well as in Russian banks and private companies. Grigory graduated with distinction from the Financial University under the Government of Russian Federation and holds MSc in Management degree from EMLYON Business School (France). He is also CFA Charterholder. Grigory coordinates projects in the field of M&A and Corporate Finance.

title: Doniyor  Islamov
content: Doniyor has more than 10 years of experience in finance and M&A. Doniyor began his career in PwC, was CFO in several international companies. Doniyor is currently in charge of M&A and corporate finance projects in Uzbekistan and Kazahstan.

title: Alexey Goryachev
content: Alexey has more than 25 years of experience in investments and financial advisory services. Prior to joining RB Partners as a Senior Partner, he was a Co-Founder and a Managing Partner of RMG Partners (2014-2016). He began his career as an economist in the State Statistical Committee of the Russian Federation in 1989. Between 1990-1991 he was the chief expert of the stock department of the first Russian stock exchange, in 1991-1992 a co-founder and director of one of the first Russian investment companies «Shares of Russia», in 1992-1994 a manager of the National Investment Fund, 1994 -2014 a Co-founder, President, Chairman of the Board of Directors in RMG Partners. Education: Financial Academy of the Russian Government, MBA Kennedy Western University, Executive MBA Skolkovo, Berkeley HAAS, Harvard Business School. YPO (Young Presidents Organization) Moscow Chapter Chair, Master of Business, EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2015. Alex is in charge of M&A transactions support.

title: Alexander Lukin
content:
Alexander has more than 25 years’ experience in the financial and industrial sectors. Prior to joining RB Partners, he held the positions of Deputy Director in Basic Element, Financial Director in Deutsche UFG, Member of Executive Board in Gazprom Media and leading positions in the Sputnik Group and NTV Plus. Alexander worked is a member of the Board of Directors in
the company Element Leasing. Alexander graduated from Lomonosov Moscow State University, he is a member of the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), Great Britain, and he has the professional qualification of Chartered Director in the field of corporate finance. Alexander is in charge of M&A projects.

title: Arseniy Dabbakh
content: Arseniy has more than 20 years of experience in sales, marketing and finance. Prior to joining RB Partners as a Partner, a Co-Founder and a Managing Partner of RMG Partners (2014-2016). He began his career in IT sector in 3M Co. in 1995. 1997-2003 worked in sales & marketing in various tech companies Duracell, Digitex Europe, etc. In 2005-2010, a Co-Founder and Managing Partner of invest boutique Gurus Capital, focused on M&A cross border transactions in MidCap. 2010-2014 worked in investment bank RMG, Corporate Finance Director and Head of investments. Education: RUDN University, MBA California State University, Skolkovo PE/VC. Investor & board member of several tech startups. Board member and Head of VC Committee of National Alternative Investments Managers Association (www.naima-russia.org). Arseniy is in charge of transaction support with hi-tech companies and VC market analysis.

title: Maxim Seltzer
content: Maxim is a banker with over 20 years of experience in direct investments, M&A, capital markets and financing transactions. Over the years Maxim focused on cross-border transactions and clients in Emerging Markets in Central and Eastern Europe, Russia, Israel, Singapore, Japan and China. Maxim has held executive positions at Haitong Securities, STJ Advisors, Nomura and Daiwa-SMBC. Maxim has started his banking career at the treasury of the Bank of Montreal in Toronto and later moved to EBRD in London working with clients in the Financial Institutions Group. Maxim is a CFA Charter Holder and has an MBA degree from the Schulich Business School (Toronto, Canada).
